chunks: They will ask you about the mountains. Tell them: 'My Lord will uproot them from the base, scattering them to pieces.'

key_terms.نَسْفًا: Scattering to pieces / uprooting from the base

ai.seo_question: What will happen to the mountains on the Day of Judgment according to Surah Taa-Haa?
ai.summary: In the context of Surah Taa-Haa, this verse responds to the disbelievers' skepticism about the physical stability of the earth on the Day of Judgment by emphasizing God's absolute power to obliterate even the most enduring natural features. Shia exegetes, such as Allamah Tabatabai, highlight that 'Yansifuha' (He will scatter/pulverize) signifies a complete dismantling of the mountain's structural integrity, serving as a tangible sign of the Resurrection's reality. This event underscores the transient nature of the material world compared to the eternal dominion of the Creator.
